githubActivityNote: Some of the work — like my thesis or the larger Jarvis project — doesn't always show up as commits here. I build Jarvis solo, keep working copies locally, and only commit finished, stable versions instead of ten small tweaks a day — that's just more practical for solo development. On a team production project it calls for exactly the opposite — frequent, small atomic commits, a clear change history, and code review through pull requests, similar to the CI/CD workflow already set up on my other projects.
